label: Refrigerator

questions.text: Does the door close firmly with the seal touching all round?
questions.why: A leaking seal lets cold air out and makes the compressor work harder.

questions.text: Does the power at home often dip, flicker or trip?
questions.why: Unsteady power can damage the electronics.

questions.text: Is it plugged into a surge protector or stabilizer?
How much space is there behind and beside the fridge?
questions.why: The fridge releases heat at the back and sides.

questions.text: How full is the fridge usually?
questions.why: Packing it too tight blocks the cold air from moving.

questions.text: Is there thick ice inside the freezer?
questions.why: Thick ice means the fridge works harder (or a defrost problem on frost-free models).

questions.text: Have you noticed weak cooling, water under the fridge or unusual noise?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Switch off and unplug the fridge before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning an appliance that is plugged in risks an electric shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the fridge yourself; leave repairs to the brand's authorised service.
care_tips.why: Inside there are live parts, and opening it can also end the warranty.

care_tips.text: Use a stabilizer of the right rating if the power at home is unsteady.
care_tips.why: Voltage swings can damage the compressor and the control board.

care_tips.text: Keep the door seal clean and check it closes firmly all round.
care_tips.why: A good seal keeps the cold in.

care_tips.text: Leave space behind and beside the fridge for air to flow.
care_tips.why: Trapped heat makes the compressor run longer.

care_tips.text: Leave gaps between items so cold air can move.
care_tips.why: Air needs room to cool everything evenly.

care_tips.text: If thick ice builds up, follow your manual's defrost steps or contact the brand's service.
If cooling gets weak, water collects under the fridge or new noises start, contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: Small cooling faults can spoil food and grow into bigger repairs.

care_tips.text: Let hot food cool down before putting it in.
care_tips.why: Hot food makes the fridge work harder.

reminders.text: Wipe the fridge door seal and check it closes firmly.
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.

reminders.text: Ask for the coils at the back to be checked and dusted at a service visit.
reminders.note: Check your manual and warranty card for service advice.
